newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Mideast and African port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ISRAEL, July 29 Haifa - Eight vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected. Discharging at berth, 4 general cargo. 2 Bulk, loading/discharging at berth, 3 containers, 3 tankers. Waiting at anchorage to load/discharge, 2 general cargo, 1 container, 1 passenger, 1 tanker. 2 Bulk waiting at anchorage to discharge, 2 under repair/drydock, 2 awaiting orders. Ashdod - Two to three days delay, 1 general cargo discharging at berth, 1 bulker loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth. Loading/discharging at berth, 3 containers, 1 passenger. 8 General cargo discharging at anchorage, 2 bulk loading at anchorage, 2 discharging at anchorage, 1 tanker loading/discharging at anchorage. 2 Under repair/drydock, 2 awaiting orders. Eilat - One bulker loading at berth 1 passenger loading/discharging at berth.
JORDAN, July 26 - Aqaba - Three vessels loading at berth, 5 discharging, 6 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 to discharge, 1 awaiting orders.

MOZAMBIQUE, July 28 - Nacala - Port working normally (first come, first served). No restriction on berthing and sailing at night. Draft restriction 9.5 metres at general cargo berths and 14 metres at container berths. One tug available. Beira - General cargo berths working normally. 24 Hour berthing/sailing for vessels up to 140 metres loa. Some restriction for larger vessels and subject to prior arrangement with port captain. Max. draft for 24 hour navigation 7.5 metres. 2 Tugs available. General access channel - 2 Waverider buoys deployed in approach. Each buoy approx. 1 metre diameter with flashing orange light. Flash frequency five one second flashes every 26 seconds. Maputo - Berthing/sailing of 24 hours for vessels up to 120 metres loa. Some restrictions for larger vessels and subject to prior arrangements with port captain. All berths fluid. Draft restriction in channel 9 metres less 0.5 metres plus rise of tide. Max. draft for 24 hour navigation is 9 metres.
NAMIBIA, July 28 - Walvis Bay - Working normally.

UNITED ARAB EMIRATES, July 26 - Dubai - Containers - 24 Vessels due, no delays expected. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 1 bunkering, 1 under repair/laid up. General cargo - 10 Vessels due, no delays expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 8 discharging at berth, 3 under repair/laid up. Tankers - 5 Vessels due, no delays expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 8 under repair/laid up.

YEMEN, July 28 - Hodeidah - Seven vessels alongside of which 1 bulk corn, 3 wheat flour, 1 steel, 1 timber, 1 general cargo. 3 Vessels anchored of which 1 wheat flour, 1 steel, 1 general cargo. Berthing waiting time - General cargo, containers up to 1 day, bagged cargo up to 3 days, bulk cargo up to 5 days. Mokha - No vessels alongside. Hodeidah - Vessels berthed, 1 steel, 1 timber/plywood, 3 flour, 1 equipment, 1 yellow corn/sbn. 2 Vessels anchored awaiting berth of which 1 steel, 1 flour. Berthing delays, reefers 36 hours, general cargo 3-4 days, bagged cargo/bulk wheat/corn 5-7 days.
